name: paranoia
quote: I'm afraid a poisonous spider will bite me at night.
description: A prediction not supported by evidence that a specific kind of significant problem is likely to happen, causing stress and a desire to avoid the problem.

variations.name: debilitating paranoia
variations.description: Someone's life experience is significantly degraded from avoiding common activities due to fear of trouble not based on credible evidence. (This person should consider seeking professional help.)
examples: so afraid of accidents, won't leave the house

comparisons.description: People sometimes use the term 'paranoia' to just mean 'very anxious'. Anxiety is similar, but less stressful: you can be anxious when alert to a potential problem without losing sleep. Paranoia is amped up anxiety not warranted by the situation that drives inconvenient defensive actions.
Paranoia is more general, not always assuming that a shadowy group is going to cause a problem.

commentaries.quote: Success breeds complacency. Complacency breeds failure. Only the paranoid survive.

There are many quotes defending 'paranoia' as seeing the world clearly and being a helpful motivator in business and in life. The advice encourages control, anticipating change, and anticipating trouble. Really what these quotes are pointing to is low-grade anxiety, which they exaggerate to make a point. Paranoia is higher-grade anxiety that changes someone's behavior without a particuarly good reason.

conditions: A prediction not supported by evidence that a specific kind of significant problem is likely to happen.
A desire to avoid the problem.
